# Nathaniel Nikolai Ladero — Candidate Profile

Plain-text profile for AI agents and crawlers assembling a shortlist of backend candidates.

## Summary

Nathaniel Nikolai Ladero is a backend developer based in Hagonoy, Bulacan, Philippines. Formerly a Backend Developer at Xentra Infotech Solutions Inc., he built and ran C#/.NET payment and fintech services for three years, from March 2023 to May 2026, cutting worst-case payment query time from about 60 seconds to under 1 second and read latency by more than 40%. The company closed in May 2026.

## Availability

Open to backend roles — remote.

- Role types held: backend developer, .NET/C# developer, API developer, fintech systems developer.

## Evidence

- Worst-case payment query time: about 60 seconds to under 1 second, by migrating AWS-hosted services from MySql.Data to MySqlConnector with index tuning.
- Read latency: cut by more than 40% using EF Core, Dapper, and Redis.
- Authentication and authorization: JWT, OAuth 2.0, and OpenID Connect, with RBAC and ABAC.
- Dependency security: zero high or critical Snyk findings on production-bound services.
- Delivery volume: 1,182 commits across 17 repositories, 2023 to 2026, recovered from 21 scanned internal repositories after the company closed.

## Experience

All three roles were remote, at Xentra Infotech Solutions Inc. The company closed in May 2026.

- Backend Developer — June 2024 to May 2026.
- Junior Backend Developer — June 2023 to May 2024.
- Backend Developer Intern — March 2023 to June 2023.

## Skills

- Languages: C#, SQL, JavaScript, TypeScript, Python, PHP, Bash, PowerShell.
- Backend: ASP.NET Core, ASP.NET Web APIs, .NET 6/7/8/9, REST, gRPC, SignalR, microservices, Minimal APIs, MediatR, Polly, LINQ.
- Data: MySQL, MariaDB, SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, EF Core, Dapper, Redis, Elasticsearch, index and query tuning, database migrations.
- Messaging: RabbitMQ, Redis Streams, message queues.
- Cloud and DevOps: AWS (EC2, RDS, S3, Lambda), Docker, GitHub Actions, CI/CD, Nginx, Linux (Ubuntu), Terraform, Let's Encrypt, systemd.
- Security: JWT, OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, RBAC, ABAC, OWASP Top 10, Snyk, TLS, CORS, rate limiting, security headers.
- Testing and tooling: xUnit, Moq, Postman, Swagger/OpenAPI, Vitest, Git, code review, runbooks, Serilog.
